data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 暖灯卧榻暗梅蕾丝轻依
data.action: 跪坐软床边缘细肩带微滑微抿红唇望来
data.lighting: 床头暖橘台灯与窗外柔和夜色
data.description: 关上房门后，暖橘色的床头灯把整张软床烘得柔和静谧。提弗洛斯换上暗梅紫丝绒薄纱寝衣跪坐在柔软床褥间，黑色细带轻轻滑过白皙肩头，双腿交叠着把龙尾温柔绕到身侧。她抬眸看着你，平日猎手的果断化作只对你流露的柔软依赖。
data.promptProse: Kneeling across soft rumpled bedsheets in the amber glow of a bedside lamp, Typhoeus wears translucent dark-plum velvet lace lingerie with one narrow strap slipping down her shoulder, gazing at the viewer with flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: She kneels on the soft bedsheets in warm lamp light with a slipping strap, gazing intimately at the viewer with a soft blush.
